entry.title: Personalized causal effects for longitudinal continuous treatments
entry.summary: We study personalized causal effect estimation for longitudinal data with continuous treatments. A transformer outcome model is combined with doubly robust estimation.

entry.title: Personalized causal effects for longitudinal continuous treatments
entry.summary: We study personalized causal effect estimation for longitudinal data with continuous treatments. A transformer outcome model is combined with a doubly robust estimator and an updated identification argument.

entry.title: Recurrent models for heterogeneous longitudinal treatment effects
entry.summary: This work estimates heterogeneous causal effects from longitudinal observations. A recurrent neural network represents treatment history and supports personalization.

entry.title: Doubly robust learning with continuous treatment trajectories
entry.summary: We develop a doubly robust causal estimator for longitudinal continuous treatment trajectories. Simulation experiments evaluate the estimator under nuisance-model misspecification.

entry.title: Causal forests for individualized effects in repeated measures
entry.summary: We analyze individualized causal effects with repeated-measure data. The method uses causal forests and evaluates treatment heterogeneity in an empirical study.

entry.title: Particle formation in a distant galaxy
entry.summary: We measure star formation in a distant galaxy using multi-band telescope observations. Spectral features characterize the surrounding gas.
